llm.summary: This is a markdown-only creative storyboard skill with disclosed, purpose-aligned guidance and no evidence of hidden execution, data access, persistence, or credential use.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request filesystem, network, credential, browser profile, API, or system-level access beyond loading its own reference markdown.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact consists of markdown files only, with no executable scripts, package installation steps, hooks, or command-running instructions.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are broad creative workflow guidance and include safety/content quality constraints; there is a minor path typo using `reference/` while bundled files are under `references/`, but this is operational rather than security-relevant.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, memory writes, local indexing, or account-modifying behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill provides Chinese-language guidance for turning scripts or copy into video storyboards, including narrative structure, shot language, asset descriptions, and image-generation prompts; these capabilities fit its stated creative purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Safe to install for storyboard and video-planning help. Users should still review generated marketing claims, rights-sensitive visuals, and medical or other regulated claims before publishing; the bundled guidance itself does not perform those actions automatically.
